name: CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2026
information: This competition is recognized by **[CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/)** as the Southeast [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2026. Residents of **Alabama**, **Florida**, **Georgia**, **North Carolina**, **South Carolina**, and **Tennessee** are eligible for the title of Southeast Champion - please see the [Southeast Residency tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2026#62156-southeast-residency) for more information. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQzMTc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cb3247b4723a89667b181660cbc20065f92b7a90/SEC%2026%20logo.png) This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2026#62162-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
